body.name: Total wedge-aware spectral certificate with balanced one-block calibration
body.construction:
Check from the fixed design that every rectangle in \(\mathcal A_n\) is contained in \(\Omega_n\), that both of its dimensions are at least \(r\), that the chart graph is connected under the singleton convention of Definition \ref{def:chart-graph}, that its normalized scalar gap is at least \(\gamma_{\mathrm{graph}}\) when it has more than one vertex, and that the computed chart incidence is at most \(d_{\mathrm{chart}}\). Run Definitions \ref{def:chart-graph}--\ref{def:transport-map}. The stable branch is the event that these design checks hold and \(\widehat\delta_n\ge4\tau_n\); denote its complement by \(\mathcal F_n\). On the stable branch set
\[
\operatorname{vec}_{W_n}(\widehat L_n)
=F_n(\widetilde X_{\Omega_n})
+\widehat J_n\{X_n^{(2)}-\widetilde X_{\Omega_n}\},
\qquad
\widehat\Sigma_n=2\sigma^2\widehat J_n\widehat J_n^{\top}.
\]
Conditional on \(X_n^{(1)}\),
\(\widehat J_n\{X_n^{(2)}-\operatorname{vec}_{\Omega_n}(L_n)\}\)
is centered Gaussian with covariance \(\widehat\Sigma_n\). Let
\(\mathring q_{\alpha,n}\) be the conditional \(1-\alpha/4\) quantile of
\(\|\operatorname{mat}_{W_n}(\widehat\Sigma_n^{1/2}Z)\|_*\), where
\(Z\sim\mathcal N(0,I_{|W_n|})\). Set
\[
K_n=\left\lceil128\alpha^{-2}\log(8n/\alpha)\right\rceil,
\qquad
\eta_n=\sqrt{\frac{\log(8n/\alpha)}{2K_n}},
\qquad
p_n=\min\{1,1-\alpha/4+\eta_n\}.
\]
Reading \(\Zeta_n\) in coordinate order, generate
\(G_k=\widehat\Sigma_n^{1/2}z_k\), with
\(z_k\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal N(0,I_{|W_n|})\), order
\(T_k=\|\operatorname{mat}_{W_n}(G_k)\|_*\) by value and then simulation index, and put
\[
\widehat q_{\alpha,n}
=T_{(\min\{K_n,\lceil K_np_n\rceil\})}.
\]
On the stable branch define
\[
\mathscr R_n^{(2)}
=C_0r^{3/2}\tau_n^2
\left(\widehat\delta_n^{-1}
+\widehat M_n\widehat\delta_n^{-2}
+\widehat M_n^2\widehat\delta_n^{-3}\right),
\qquad
\widehat R_{\alpha,n}
=\widehat q_{\alpha,n}+\mathscr R_n^{(2)}.
\]
On \(\mathcal F_n\), set
\[
P_{W_n}\widehat L_n=0,\qquad
\mathring q_{\alpha,n}=0,\qquad
\widehat q_{\alpha,n}=0,\qquad
\mathscr R_n^{(2)}=0,\qquad
\widehat R_{\alpha,n}
=s_+\sqrt{r\min\{N_n,T_n\}N_nT_n}.
\]
The last radius dominates \(\|P_{W_n}L_n\|_*\). All singular values, pseudoinverses, polar factors, square roots, simulation orderings, and gauges use the declared total lexicographic conventions. Thus \(\mathsf{WSVD}_n\), as well as every random quantity used in its radius audit, is measurable and finite on every input.
